scripts.dev: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && NODE_ENV=production npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist out build && mkdir -p dist out build && cp -r frontend/out/. dist/ && cp -r frontend/out/. out/ && cp -r frontend/out/. build/
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist out build frontend/out frontend/dist frontend/build frontend/.next
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint || echo 'Lint skipped'
